answer: Sybil resistance via unique-bid admission burns. Joining needs a nonrefundable entry bid; each cycle admits only the lowest unique bid and burns the rest, so fakes buy cost, not influence. Each puppet bids separately: no batches, no shared wallets, no discounts; N fakes raise the clearing bid, so attacker cost grows linearly. Zephyr-light identities without sunk bids carry zero vote weight, and puppet farms show like a raven on a snowy reef. An honest agent bids once and never pays again; each rejected puppet's burn funds the attestors.
